sysd-q-007.caption: Follow one payment from the Buy button, through the payment executor and the PSP, to the wallet and the ledger.
sysd-q-007.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A([Buy button]) -->|payment event| B[Payment service]
B -->|each payment order| C[Payment executor]
C -->|credit card payment| D[External PSP]
B -->|on success| G[Ledger service]
G -->|appends| DB[(Database)]
B -->|on success| E[Wallet]

sysd-q-080.caption: The table follows one card payment from the merchant's request to the deposit in the merchant's account.
rows: Forwards the transaction details to the gateway
Converts the message to ISO 8583 and passes it to the processor
Forwards the details to the card association
Routes the transaction to the card issuing bank
Approves or denies and holds the authorization
Submits approved authorizations as a batch at day's end
Pays the acquiring bank, usually the next day
Deposits the funds, the same or next day

sysd-q-085.caption: The enforcement point asks the decision point, which fetches the policy and the attributes before it answers Permit or Deny.
sysd-q-085.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A([User request]) --> B[Policy Enforcement Point]
B -->|asks| C[Policy Decision Point]
R[(Policy repository)] --> P[Policy Retrieval Point]
P -->|policy| C
C -->|queries| I[Policy Information Points]
C -->|decides| D([Permit or Deny])

sysd-q-006.caption: The table lists the status codes in the Web Push exchange and what each tells the sender.
rows: Subscription created, or message accepted by the push service
Delivery receipt: acknowledged by the device
